points.text: Five questions guide the choice: budget, access, hardware, privacy, and setup tolerance.
And you're not "worse" — agentic AI is no longer a single-tool field, there are open alternatives.

For example: Claude Code → LiteLLM → Cerebras gpt-oss-120b — Claude Code UI with an open model Aider → direct OpenRouter → DeepSeek model — classic OSS workflow Hermes → LiteLLM with a fallback chain — an example of an owner-controlled stack
This module teaches you to think about the whole stack rather than "knowing one tool".
